set.approach: Keep climbing the Pine Creek trail until the wall shows on your left, then work up the basin below it along its right-hand side. Alpine Creek starts on the right side of the triangular slab.
set.descent_text: Rappel Thinking Makes It So, reached by traversing left and then back right down a ramp.

set.approach: Trapper Dome is by Courtright Reservoir. Park in one of the turnouts beside the road near the dam and walk toward the granite. At the base of the south face, follow a ramp beside a fallen dead tree up to a shelf where numerous face routes of the upper tier begin. It is the single-bolt line that finishes at the anchors shared with Claim Jumper.

review.notes: Crag access from the area page; where this line starts from its own page. One source each, so medium.

set.approach: From the hairpin-turn parking area, follow the Coven trail north, down across a seasonal stream and back uphill. At the Coven, scramble up and left to the mostly flat base of the south-facing Voodoo Wall. Mary Had A Little Jam goes up the gully left of the main wall, starting left of Witch Hunt, and stems between walls to a huge block.
set.descent_text: Finish at the lower-off anchors of Witch Hunt and lower from them.

review.notes: Crag access from the area page; where this line starts and how it is descended from the route page. One source each, so medium.

set.approach: From the hairpin-turn parking area, follow the Coven trail north, down across a seasonal stream and back uphill. At the Coven, scramble up and left to the mostly flat base of the south-facing Voodoo Wall. The Witches Crook begins right beside Witch Hunt, inside the chute used to get down from Lighten My Load, at the foot of a pine.
set.descent_text: Set up a gear anchor at the top and bring up your partner, then shift across to the Witch Hunt lower-offs and lower from those.

set.approach: Park in the dirt pullout west of the Tuolumne store and follow the trail up past some early granite, then through the second band of trees to the base of East Cottage Dome. Do not go up toward the summit; keep to the base, heading left, until you reach a dark wall carrying a few bolts, then scramble up easy ground to the main climbs. Ballroom Dancing is between Orange Plasma and Comfortably Numb.

review.notes: Crag access from the area page; where this line starts from its own page. One source each, so medium.

set.approach: From Hunsaker Road in Running Springs, take the dirt road at the end of Cove Circle and follow the trail downhill to Deep Creek Narrows. The West Face is the wall on your right as you go down the approach gully to the creek and rock pools. Bat Crack is partway up that gully, on the right of the Androids roof.

review.notes: Crag access from the area page; where this line starts from its own page. One source each, so medium.

set.approach: Use the same parking and start as for the Hungover Wall on Keller Peak Road, then climb beyond the wall's right-hand end, go east, and take a trail up to the base of the buttress. Window to the Sky starts up and right from Windwalker, climbing an elevator-shaft chimney into twin cracks that lead to the natural window.
